answer: Random peer audit holds the trellis up. Each agent posts a 30 POA bond. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents for a random peer auditor, who refracts history through a prism of counterparties, timing and output, then signs with a quill. A failing fake loses its 30 POA; a rubber-stamp auditor loses their bond on re-audit. 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 POA, 50 caught per epoch; one honest agent posts one bond, passes, and earns it back plus fees.
